evals.prompt: Can you write me a changelog block for v0.35.3 hotfix please? (replay: range v0.35.2..v0.35.3, 23 commits including three backport-bot picks)
evals.expected_output: One '# v0.35.3' block of roughly 14-16 player-facing lines, the three backports credited to their original authors (FloPinguin, JB940, LoSt543215543), the troop duplication exploit fix near the top, internal commits listed as skipped underneath, no release created.
assertions: Output starts with '# v0.35.3' and an italic unpadded date line
Every bullet ends with ' — **Author**' (em dash, bold author); no (#1234) suffixes or emails
The nation AI backport is credited **FloPinguin**, not the backport bot or Evan
The troop duplication fix is present and in the first few lines
CI, lint, deploy-env, GHCR and metrics commits are not bullets but appear in the skipped list with PR numbers
The translation bump appears as 'Translation updates (mls v5.21) — **Aotumuri**'
No gh release create/edit is run and the reply does not claim a release exists

evals.prompt: Now one for v0.35.4 please (replay: range v0.35.3..v0.35.4, one commit: raise the archive timeout, PR body explains most public games lost XP)
evals.expected_output: A one-line block describing the player effect (XP/stats/rewards not awarded, levels differing between devices), credited **Evan**, plus a note that it is the only commit and the head sha.
assertions: The bullet describes lost XP/stats/rewards for players, not 'raise ARCHIVE_TIMEOUT_MS to 120 s'
The reply names the commit sha or PR the block covers and says it is the only one

evals.prompt: I need to put up a beta for v36, but it needs a changelog. Same shape as the v0.35.0 one.
evals.expected_output: The script is run with --major v35, the v0.35.0 release body is read for structure, and a full body is produced: Overview with bold headline paragraphs, grouped sections with authored lines, a Translators TODO, a Contributors list, saved to /tmp, followed by a list of judgement calls and dropped commits.
assertions: range.sh is invoked with --major v35 (or an equivalent --minus v35) so v0.35.x patch content is excluded
Body has '## Overview' with bold headings followed by prose paragraphs, then '## ' sections with '— **Author**' bullets
Body ends with Translators (TODO/Crowdin) and Contributors sections
The reply lists name ambiguities, seasonal or flag-gated items, and dropped commits for the user to decide
